title: The Lodestar Discipline
summary: The school course in fixing the qi on a single lodestar and striking and guiding by it until the closing descent.

title: The Aphelion Canon
summary: The school canon of the farthest point of the orbit where starlight runs slow and cold and weighs down all it touches.

title: Reckoning of the Crown of Stars
summary: The school's high reckoning of the crown of stars set about the user and loosed as a single crowning blaze.

title: The Gale Mariner Discipline
summary: The school discipline of steering by the stars in which the user guides allies and crosses the field in a single leap.

title: Treatise of the Gale Star Chart
summary: The school treatise of the sworn star chart that marks the foe's doom and brings all its lines to a close upon him.

title: The Oath Beneath the Stars
summary: The school's deepest oath sworn to the stars themselves and answered by a sworn constellation that strikes and strengthens.
